signaturePolicy.notation: Space-separated hexadecimal bytes; ?? denotes a masked byte.
signaturePolicy.scope: Signatures are checked at the listed RVA and inside the named owner function; uniqueness is recorded only where queried.
signaturePolicy.readyRule: A ready mutation must have signature.unique=true and be installed and rolled back with every other ready mutation in its atomic group.
signaturePolicy.identifiedRule: Identified means the role/RVA is established but the listed signature is not yet proven unique; it is not eligible for runtime mutation.

openGates: G0: runtime-qualify the bounded RX-relay/RW-state loader transaction, non-aligned patch-publication quiescence, register restoration, vector-resize failure paths and 4095-row behavior before declaring the cap qualified.
G1: the nine-site generic item codec group has unique exact-or-masked signatures, but remains unpublished until G10 and G9 are closed.
G2-G7: replace every remaining instruction-scoped non-unique signature with a longer unique masked signature before runtime mutation.
G8: close packet 0xAC cardinality, estimator and 0xF4-byte headroom.
G9: prove worst-case 0x9C/0x9D full-item payload sizes and resolve exclusive hook ownership.
G10: identify an authoritative player/shared-stash namespace marker and reject every unmarked stream before decode.
Runtime: no cold-start, save round-trip, stash, reconnect, multiplayer or packet-fuzz validation has been performed.
